channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Copper: Fed focus and Iran talks steer prices – ING
item.description: ING’s commodities team reports that industrial metals, led by Copper, gained as markets monitored US-Iran talks and shipping risks, while Aluminium stayed under pressure.

item.title: Gold hangs near YTD low, below $4,000 as bears await Fed Chair Warsh's speech
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone for the third straight day and trades below the $4,000 psychological mark through the first half of the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: US Dollar: Real strength and REER outlook – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu argues that the US Dollar remains undervalued in real effective terms despite recent gains in USD/JPY, EUR/USD and USD/CAD. He notes that Eurozone growth and inflation have softened while U.S. price dynamics strengthen, supporting further appreciation in the Dollar’s REER.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD dips below $58 weighed by higher US yields
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) is trading lower on Wednesday, with the US Dollar buoyed by strong US macroeconomic data and higher US Treasury yields.

item.title: Why is the British Pound holding steady when the United Kingdom is facing a political transition?
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is showing resilience against a backdrop of local political shifts and brewing fiscal questions.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Sticks to gains near 101.35 as bulls await Fed's Warsh
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, attracts fresh buyers on Wednesday amid uncertainty over Middle East diplomacy and elevated expectations of US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hikes.

item.title: Indian Rupee: RBI smoothing caps upside – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists describe a quiet start to Q3 for USD/INR, with the pair marginally bid but capped below its 50‑day moving average near 95.02.

item.title: Euro declines ahead of Eurozone HICP inflation data
item.description: EUR/USD depreciates after flattening in the previous day, trading around 1.1390 during the European hours on Wednesday. The Euro (EUR) remains weaker ahead of Eurozone Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) data due to be released later in the day.

item.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI expected to signal continued expansion in US factory activity
item.description: Attention shifts to Wednesday’s release of the June ISM Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI), one of the most closely followed indicators of activity in the US manufacturing sector and an important barometer of the broader economy.

item.title: British Pound decline against US Dollar, eyes on key US data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is down 0.22% to near 1.3234 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday. The GBP/USD pair trades lower as surging United States (US) Treasury Yields have strengthened the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Australian Dollar: Neutral stance inside broader range against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang reports AUD/USD rebounded sharply from 0.6867 to 0.6930, with the move seen as stretched and intraday trade expected between 0.6890 and 0.6930, below 0.6935.

item.title: Forex Today: Markets await comments from leaders of major central banks
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, July 1:

item.title: British Pound consolidates near two-month high vs bearish JPY as intervention risks loom
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross is seen consolidating its strong gains registered over the past two days and oscillating in a range through the early European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Rate hike bets vanish as inflation falls – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose notes that weaker-than-expected Polish inflation has erased market expectations for 2026 rate hikes and could even revive rate cut discussions by Q4.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds losses as US Dollar strengthens on safe-haven demand
item.description: NZD/USD loses ground after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.5670 during the early European hours.

item.title: Brent: Supply recovery pressures prices – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that ICE Brent ended the second quarter sharply lower as markets price a recovery in Persian Gulf supply and record US output.

item.title: Swiss Franc drifts lower, nearing 0.8100 USD despite solid Swiss Retail Sales
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) is trading lower for the second consecutive day against a strong US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, showing little impact from the positive surprise in Swiss Real Retail Sales. The USD/CHF pair appreciates 0.14% so far on the day, and approaches intra-week highs in the 0.8100 area.

item.title: S&P 500: Tech-led gains support equities – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid and team note that the S&P 500 ended Q2 strongly, with the index up 0.79% on the day and delivering its best quarter since Q2 2020.

item.title: Indian Rupee drops amid surging US Treasury Yields, US data awaited
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 94.72 as stronger United States (US) Treasury Yields and higher US Dollar have diminished the appeal of risk-sensitive currencies.

item.title: WTI tumbles to four-month low below $69.50 as Hormuz traffic climbs
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $69.40 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The WTI price falls as the number of vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz shows signs of recovery amid progress toward easing Middle East tensions.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Pressured by policy uncertainty against US Dollar – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes that global market attention remains on the Japanese Yen (JPY) as USD/JPY trades near 162.60.

item.title: Australian Dollar underperforms as rallying US Treasury Yields prompt risk-off mood
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is down against its major currency peers, trading 0.45% lower to near 0.6890 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound: Upside capped against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang notes a slight pickup in GBP/USD upward momentum after a swing between 1.3213 and 1.3277, with a retest of 1.3275 possible but further gains seen limited.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Rebounds toward nearly 15-month highs, 1.4250
item.description: USD/CAD posts gains after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 1.4210 during the European hours on Wednesday. The pair is positioned close to nearly 15-month highs.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecasts: Euro hesitates above 0.8600 amid easing downside pressure
item.description: The Euro (EUR) remains practically flat near 11-month lows against the British Pound (GBP) on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro: Limited upside as Dollar stays supported – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke argues that the Dollar remains hard to beat as markets await a peace agreement and clarity on US politics and inflation. Strong US data and hawkish FOMC commentary are seen supporting the USD, but she doubts much further upside.

item.title: Japan’s Mimura says past Japanese Yen intervention demonstrated effect
item.description: Atsushi Mimura, Japan’s Vice Finance Minister for International Affairs and top foreign exchange official, said that intervention to prop up the yen two months ago was successful, and some US authorities voiced support, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Weakens to near 1.1400 as ECB hike bets recede, bearish vibe prevails
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades on a negative note near 1.1410 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Cooling inflation in Germany has lowered expectations for the European Central Bank (ECB) rate hikes, weighing on the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Extends rally to near 162.70 amid soaring US bond yields
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades 0.1% higher to near 162.73 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The pair reflects strength as surging United States (US) Treasury Yields have strengthened the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Swiss Franc declines ahead of Swiss Real Retail Sales, SVME PMI data
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground for the second consecutive day, trading around 0.8090 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Traders will likely observe the upcoming Swiss Real Retail Sales and SVME Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data due later in the day.
